## T5_modifications — Screening of architecture, loss and optimiser changes

| Change | Component | Base | Seeds | mAP50-95 | Δ vs base | p (Welch) | AP50-95 mismanaged | Background FP | GFLOPs | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SPD-Conv downsampling | Backbone | YOLO12n | 3 | 0.9693 ± 0.0049 | -0.0003 | 0.916 | 0.9215 | 451 | 9.86 | Not adopted: no significant difference, +56% GFLOPs |
| Varifocal Loss | Loss | YOLO12n | 3 | 0.9738 ± 0.0020 | +0.0042 | 0.100 | 0.9314 | 1531 | 6.32 | Not adopted: no significant difference, background FP ×3.5 |
| A2C2f → A2C2fRep (attention removed) | Backbone | YOLO12n | 3 | 0.9553 ± 0.0062 | -0.0143 | 0.041 | 0.8892 | 535 | 6.79 | Not adopted: significant loss |
| Class-balanced focal loss | Loss | YOLO11n | 3 | 0.9529 ± 0.0052 | -0.0090 | 0.080 | 0.8825 | 1950 | 6.32 | Not adopted: no significant difference, background FP ×3.8 |
| RepC3k2 (re-parameterisation) | Backbone | YOLO11n | 1 | 0.9595 | -0.0024 |  | 0.8869 | 384 | 6.32 | Not adopted: accuracy loss (single seed) |
| SCS-Head | Head | YOLO11n | 1 | 0.9258 | -0.0361 |  | 0.8018 | 643 | 6.03 | Not adopted: accuracy loss (single seed) |
| SimAM attention | Backbone | YOLO11n | 1 | 0.9501 | -0.0118 |  | 0.8559 | 664 | 6.32 | Not adopted: accuracy loss (single seed) |
| BiFPN weighted fusion | Neck | YOLO11n | 1 | 0.9596 | -0.0023 |  | 0.8768 | 403 | 6.32 | Not adopted: within seed noise (single seed) |
| AdamW (lr0 0.001) instead of auto | Optimiser | YOLO11n @768 | 1 | 0.9613 | -0.0102 |  | 0.9054 | 481 | 9.1 | Not adopted: accuracy loss (single seed) |

_Base references (3 seeds, 640 px): YOLO11n 0.9619 ± 0.0023, YOLO12n 0.9696 ± 0.0026; R6 compared with YOLO11n trained at 768 px. p not available for single-seed runs._
